datong_day3_chartered_car_full_loop.notes_base: RECOMMENDED: One chartered private car for the full Day 3 loop — most efficient given the cross-region distances. Full itinerary: Hotel departure ~11:30 → Yungang Grottoes (云冈石窟, ~16 km west, ~30 min) → BOOKED visit 12:30-14:30 → Drive Yungang to Hanging Monastery (悬空寺/Xuankong Si, ~90 km via 大同绕城高速, ~90-120 min) → afternoon Hanging Monastery visit (on-site ticket, allow 1.5-2h) → Drive Hanging Monastery back to Datong Ancient City (~65 km, ~90 min) → return ~19:30 for dinner. Total driving: ~250 km across the loop. Charter price: 600-800 CNY total per vehicle (not per person). Two people split = ~300-400 CNY per person for the full day including all waiting. How to arrange: (1) Ask 屿悦民宿 reception on arrival — B&B hosts know local drivers; (2) Didi Day-Use (滴滴日租) in the Didi app; (3) Negotiate at taxi stand near hotel. IMPORTANT timing: Yungang Grottoes tickets already BOOKED for 12:30 — driver must depart hotel by 11:30 to arrive by ~12:00 (allow 30 min buffer from grottoes gates to entry). Hanging Monastery (悬空寺) tickets purchased on-site at the gate. Note: Confirm Hanging Monastery open hours before departure (typically 08:00-18:00 in May, last entry 17:30).
datong_day3_chartered_car_full_loop.notes_local: 推荐方案：第3天全天安排一辆包车完成大同周边环线——考虑到各景点之间的跨区距离，包车是最高效的出行方式。全天行程：约11:30从屿悦民宿出发 → 云冈石窟（约16公里，约30分钟）→ 已预订门票12:30-14:30参观 → 从云冈石窟驾车前往悬空寺（约90公里，经大同绕城高速，约90-120分钟）→ 下午参观悬空寺（景区购票，预留1.5-2小时）→ 从悬空寺返回大同古城（约65公里，约90分钟）→ 约19:30返回，安排晚餐。全程驾驶约250公里。包车总价：600-800元/车（非每人）。两人分摊约300-400元/人，含全天等候。预订方式：（1）抵达后联系屿悦民宿前台——民宿通常熟悉本地司机；（2）滴滴APP日租功能；（3）在住宿附近出租车停靠点直接协商。时间注意：云冈石窟门票已预订12:30入场，司机需在11:30前从酒店出发，约12:00抵达景区（预留30分钟余量）。悬空寺门票在景区现场购买。建议出发前确认悬空寺开放时间（5月通常08:00-18:00，17:30停止入场）。
